docMeta.dd: Nora Ephron’s Academy of Achievement interview

trail: Nora Ephron used this maxim, but in her own interview she says it was what her mother always told her. The appropriate distinction is between Nora’s documented repetition and the family source she names, Phoebe Ephron. Source and attribution evidence ↗

The interview establishes Nora’s recollection, not the phrase’s first appearance anywhere. It therefore does not justify calling either woman the proven original inventor of these three words. Read the supporting source ↗

schema.claimReviewed: Nora Ephron coined the maxim “Everything is copy.”
schema.faqAnswer: Nora Ephron used the phrase “Everything is copy” and said in her Academy of Achievement interview that her mother, Phoebe Ephron, repeatedly told it to her. That establishes Nora’s recollection of a family teaching, not that Nora or Phoebe is the proven first coiner.
